summary.intent: Execute all 8 plans in Phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout, req HARD-11) using the GSD wave-based orchestrator, making the IPNS verify pipeline strictly fail-closed across Rust, TypeScript, and the API layer.
summary.outcome: Completed Waves 1–2 (6/8 plans: 60-01 through 60-05, 60-07) with all build/test gates green; Wave 3 (60-06, API verify cache) was spawned but the transcript ends mid-execution. Wave 4 (60-08, operational cutover) remains as a non-autonomous human checkpoint.

repo: Worktree isolation mode cannot reliably merge agent branches back; the safe fallback for delicate crypto-cutover phases is sequential execution on the main working tree.
60-01 was forced to fold all 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms as a compile necessity, bleeding into 60-04's declared scope — plan boundaries in this phase were not strictly independent.
Cargo.lock is not automatically committed by gsd-executor subagents after Cargo.toml dependency additions; this creates a latent --locked CI break discovered only mid-next-plan.
sdk-core has 34 ipns-specific tests within its 251-test suite; API ipns specs total 159 tests, with ERROR lines representing negative-path assertions (not failures).
ciborium and cipherbox-core were added as new dependencies of crates/api-client in 60-01 (CBOR Validity parsing for resolve-side expiry enforcement).

code.finding: File deleted in 60-04 — implementation relocated to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs; a post-deletion unlinked-file diagnostic was a stale snapshot, not a real error.
Last remaining VerifyError::Legacy reference; folded to VerifyError::Invalid by 60-01 as a compile necessity (not 60-04 as planned).

workflow: The gsd-executor commit helper has a known false-negative: it reports 'No staged files match any configured task' (commit_failed) even when the commit actually lands — always verify with git log after seeing this error.
Stale mid-edit diagnostics from subagents are unreliable; always run an authoritative cargo check / jest run on the main tree to confirm green status.
Jest log noise can bury the pass/fail summary; pipe through grep for the PASS/FAIL/Tests: line rather than reading raw output.
SUMMARY.md files written by executors can accumulate stale footers from post-commit self-checks; review and revert them before continuing to the next wave.

friction: gsd-executor commit helper false-negative ('commit_failed' when commit actually landed) required manual git log verification after every commit, adding overhead across multiple plans.

60-01 scope bleed: executor was forced to fold 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy arms (60-04's declared scope) as a compile necessity, making the plan boundary fiction and creating ambiguity about what 60-04 still owed.
Cargo.lock left uncommitted after 60-01 — discovered only during 60-04 cleanup as a latent --locked CI break; required an out-of-band fixup commit.
60-01-SUMMARY.md accrued a stale footer (said 'verify.rs FOUND' after 60-04 deleted it) that had to be reverted manually.
Jest ERROR lines in negative-path tests buried the actual pass/fail count, requiring a second extraction command to confirm the wave gate result.
Worktree isolation was the intended execution mode but couldn't be used — no exposed worktree path/branch manifest in the harness means no reliable merge-back, forcing slower sequential execution.
open_items: 60-06 (API publish-path verify cache, Wave 3) — spawned but transcript ends; completion status unknown.
60-08 (Wave 4) — staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test is non-autonomous; requires a human-action checkpoint to proceed.
gsd-executor commit helper false-negative is a known recurring issue with no fix in place.
Worktree isolation limitation for multi-plan phases (no merge-back path) should be documented or resolved in the harness so future phases can use parallel execution safely.
